scope: 100 assemblies × CadQuery/OpenSCAD, 200 planned cases per model
score_definition: 100 * mean(Geo, Judge, Part); Topo and Valid are separate diagnostics.
api_failure_policy: Generation API failures are unrun and excluded; non-API invalid outputs receive worst scores. Missing evaluations retain the existing per-metric denominators.
valid_definition: Valid/tested per format; Average Valid is the equal-weight mean of both formats.
cost_definition: Displayed USD/case is total recorded generation cost divided by total tested case-format outputs. Invalid outputs are included. Evaluator calls are excluded. Historical cost_usd/estimated_cost_usd fields retain their original equal-format accounting; cost_usd_per_case is the pooled display value. Kimi remains an official-tokenizer estimate.

assumptions.source: Saved condition text, prior generated code, error feedback, historical system prompts and unchanged user/refine templates. Official K3 tokenizer and XTML framing recount saved reasoning and answer text.
assumptions.limits: Estimate, not API-reported usage or an invoice. Original full request bodies, images and cache-hit counters are unavailable. Two responses have 17 answer characters not reconstructed. Code fences restored where lengths match. Original API serialization or tokenizer revision may differ.

cost_estimate.formula: Mean of CadQuery/OpenSCAD per-tested-case generation costs; includes initial/correction and invalid cases, excludes API failed. Reasoning is counted exactly once.

aggregate.incomplete_run_reason: 3 case(s) have API-phase output awaiting local eval. Run --local-eval-only to finish.

judge_definition: Equal-weight mean of geometry, aesthetics and semantic ratings, each normalized by (s - 1) / 9; existing per-metric denominators are retained.

judge_reaggregation.method: Equal mean of all three normalized saved Judge axes; no model calls.
judge_reaggregation.population: Same release snapshot; coverage, non-Judge buckets and costs retained.

scoring_revision.geometry: Normalize per case; average CD score, F@0.01, NC and measured IoU within each valid case, then average case scores within each format.
scoring_revision.text_iou: Omit unavailable IoU from the valid case geometry mean; retain generation-invalid cases as failures.
scoring_revision.part: Mean of match F1 and F-score mean over all Hungarian pairs; no normalized part mean.
scoring_revision.part_sampling_rng: MT19937 legacy uniform sequence with explicit Generator
scoring_revision.iou: Omit unavailable IoU from a valid case Geo mean. Standalone IoU averages measured values from valid outputs plus zero contributions from invalid outputs; only valid-but-unavailable measurements are omitted, and measured zeros are retained.

casewise_geometry_policy.geometry: Normalize per case; average CD score, F@0.01, NC and measured IoU within each valid case, then average case scores within each format.
casewise_geometry_policy.invalid: Generation-invalid outputs contribute zero Geo. Preserve released API-unrun exclusions and missing-evaluation exclusions.
casewise_geometry_policy.iou: Omit unavailable IoU from a valid case Geo mean. Standalone IoU averages measured values from valid outputs plus zero contributions from invalid outputs; only valid-but-unavailable measurements are omitted, and measured zeros are retained.
casewise_geometry_policy.cd: Cap each measured CD at 0.01 before normalization and reporting; invalid outputs receive CD=0.01.
casewise_geometry_policy.formats: Average task-supported formats equally after averaging cases.
